thread:
olivia (SE): Heads-up — VellumHealth POC smoke run scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: sustained 150 qps gen (avg 16 tokens) with 99th < 220ms. Need final runbook & pricing ask.
carlos (sales): Thanks. Are we still on 3 dedicated GPUs w/ burst? They'll want cost estimate for 150qps steady and 500qps short bursts.
devon (eng-runtime): Yes default plan is 3x A10G, batch_size=8, dynamic batching window 20ms, kv-cache enabled. For 150qps we expect ~180 ms p99 with current model quant.
olivia (SE): @devon can you paste the exact commands we'll run? ops will need them for infra.
devon (eng-runtime): Sure — run
```bash
redwood run --model redwood-med-1 --replicas 3 --gpu-type a10g --batch-size 8 --burst-cap 500
redwood loadtest --qps 150 --duration 30m --pattern poisson
```
Notes: use token cap 512, disable streaming for stable latency.

infra-bot: Deploy job queued: job_id=vela-8892 — estimated start 08:40 PT.

anya (security): Quick sec note — VellumHealth requires E2E encryption and SOC2 checklist. We promised to confirm no model weights leave their VPC. We'll run Private mode?

carlos (sales): They said private control plane preferred if perf acceptable. Include cost delta in the estimate pls.
devon (eng-runtime): Private adds ~15% infra premium plus network egress separate. For POC quote: hosted baseline $X/hr vs private $Y/hr. I'll put numbers after test.
olivia (SE): For measurements we'll collect: p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU/GPU util, mem, kernel preemption, and tail spikes. Bring per-route token cost too.
devon (eng-runtime): Also watch cold starts: include a 10-min warmup and a 2-min cool-down between ramps. We'll seed KV cache with representative prefixes.
carlos (sales): @olivia can you confirm SLA ask? They want max 5% error budget for p99 breaches.
olivia (SE): Confirmed. We'll run two 30m sustained windows and one 10m microburst to 500qps. If p99 > 220ms, escalate to fallback model (smaller quant).

infra-bot: Loadtest started 2024-05-15T16:00:00Z — running ora-load-4350. Streaming disabled.

devon (eng-runtime): First 10m warmup looks good. GPU util ~78%, avg token time 12ms.
olivia (SE): Noted — sensor shows 210ms p99 at 150qps with current quant. Uploading raw logs to /poc/vellumhealth/4350.
carlos (sales): Great. Can you include an itemized estimate for steady vs burst? I need it for tomorrow's pricing call.

anya (security): Also attaching the signed minimal DPIA and noting KMS integration required for private deployment.
devon (eng-runtime): Post-run summary: sustained 150qps -> p50 45ms, p95 120ms, p99 215ms. Burst 500qps (3min) -> p99 480ms but CPU bounded; recommend temporary autoscale to 5 GPUs for bursts.
olivia (SE): Action items: devon to add cost delta and autoscale runbook; anya to confirm KMS steps; carlos to prepare pricing slide. I'll draft the exec summary.
carlos (sales): On it. Thanks team :thumbsup:
olivia (SE): tagging @exec for visibility. End.
